dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Root, very far ahead, very deep...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Pahsiv, what else do you know about the purple thing?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Purple thing, very scary. Pahsiv, go near, scared...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The blue thing... A vishap, perhaps? A vishap was fighting the purple thing?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Pahsiv! But... purple thing, very scary. Blue thing, lost lots of.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #But don't worry, {NICKNAME} is very powerful, too! {NICKNAME}'s taken down just about everything before.
